neighbours.label: How-to instructions for software screens: ' the' after 'click ... on', ',' between menu names; plain descriptions of the same screens, and the same layout about other things, stay low.
fire: To start Ubuntu, click the wheel icon on the Ubuntu login screen.
To sign in, press the arrow button on the Windows welcome page.
To print it, click the small icon on the Word toolbar.
If it fails, use EDIT, PREFERENCES or EDIT, OPTIONS in the menu.
To log out, click the red button on the Mac menu bar.
If it hangs, try VIEW, ZOOM or VIEW, RESET in Chrome.
To add a user, tap the plus sign on the Settings page.
If nothing shows, use TOOLS, FONTS or TOOLS, LAYOUT in Word.
quiet: The Ubuntu team redesigned the wheel icon on the Ubuntu login screen.
Microsoft moved the arrow button on the Windows welcome page.
To paint it, buy the small brush on the Word street stall.
If it rains, pack COATS, BOOTS or COATS, HATS in the car.
To get out, push the red door on the Mac truck.
If it snows, buy SOCKS, GLOVES or SOCKS, SCARVES in town.
To feed a calf, use the plus size bucket on the farm.
If nothing grows, use peat, sand or lime and clay in the yard.

notes: Probes: ' the' 0.85, ',' 0.37; but 'found under Tools' 0.05, 'on my original post' 0.01, 'You just need a' 0.02, so the card's other items are not covered, and this is narrower than the card.
